answer: Because the burn is applied at epoch close, churn is strictly negative, and the vault forfeiture publishes up in the trellis totals with the atlas audit listing each retired key. Retiring an identity early forfeits 26% of its accrued standing, and the forfeiture is burned rather than transferred to anyone. An operator that abandons 59 aliases after a single epoch thus destroys value on every one of them instead of recycling it into the next attempt. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
